messages:
emma_sales: Quick sync — FinReg Co asked if we can run a Dedicated POC using HSM-backed customer-managed keys in eu-west-1. They want: pricing delta vs software CMK, network/prereqs, rotation behavior, and an SOW acceptance checklist. POC window = 4w. Who can help with answers?

liam_se: We support HSM-backed CMKs for Dedicated and Private only (hosted API path different). Key things: vendor choice (AWS CloudHSM vs Azure ADH), per-HSM throughput, and network topology (VPC peering or private link + customer VPN). For POC we usually do: 1 HSM + Dedicated node group. Expect ~150–250 TPS for typical RSA/ECDH wrap ops on a single hardware module.

anna_security: Regulator asks we must disable automatic fallback to software keys — they require HSM-only enforcement. Need: (1) key custodianship policy, (2) audit log forwarding (Splunk/S3), (3) rotation SLA and ability to approve rotations manually. Also want assurance we never export raw key material off the HSM.

liam_se: Notes & sample policy snippet customers find useful:
```
{
  "KeyPolicy": {
    "Statement": [
      {"Effect":"Allow","Action":"Encrypt","Principal":"arn:...:service::redwood"},
      {"Effect":"Deny","Action":"ForceExportKeyMaterial","Principal":"*"}
    ]
  }
}
```
and quick API example to check rotation schedule:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://console.redwood.ai/v1/keys/<key-id>/rotation
```
We can expose a pending rotation state for 7 days so customer can approve.

noah_eng_infra: Heads up — EU HSM inventory is tight next 2w (capacity reservations hit). For POC we can provision 1 HSM (approx 200 TPS). If they need >1k TPS we must provision 4+ HSMs and load-balance — will impact cost and lead time. I can open an infra priority ticket. Also cross-region fallback possible but increases latency.

olivia_sales_ops: For quoting I'll need a preferred billing model: monthly surcharge per HSM + one-time setup and key-ceremony ops days. Draft pricing to start: $3,000/mo per HSM + $4k one-time ops (placeholder). I'll formalize once eng confirms exact qty and timeline. Also need SOW language for key ceremony, audit log delivery, and "no-fallback" requirement.

mike_customer: A few clarifications from our side: (1) Can rotation be automatic with a 7-day approval hold? (2) SLA requirement: 99.95% availability for key service and clear RTO for key recoverability. (3) We need audit events with per-key, per-operation granularity for attestation.

liam_se: Answers: (1) Yes — auto rotation with configurable hold (we call it "pending_approval") is supported via API/console. (2) Dedicated infra SLA is 99.95% — HSM vendor uptime is separate; we can include vendor uptime references in SOW and add an escalation path. (3) HSM logs include op-level events (Encrypt/Decrypt/Wrap/Unwrap) with timestamps — we can forward those to your logging endpoint.

anna_security: Legal checklist: confirm we do not perform outbound key export, provide SOC2/AICPA reports for the HSM provider if requested, and confirm export-control compliance (no key material leaves allowed regions without explicit sign-off). Please add these items to the security questionnaire response doc.

noah_eng_infra: Blocker: provisioning lead time could push POC start by ~10 business days if we request >1 HSM in eu-west-1. If customer is flexible, we can start initial tests with 1 HSM in eu-west-1 and scale later. I'll file INC-789 to track.

ops-bot: Quote v3 uploaded to SFDC by olivia_sales_ops — https://sfdc.example.com/quote/0053 :link:

olivia_sales_ops: I'll put SOW acceptance criteria as: p99 encrypt latency <150ms (eu-west-1), rotation test completes with manual approval flow, audit logs received and parsed by customer SIEM, key custody verified by customer during ceremony. Will attach sample SOW lines and send to legal.

mike_customer: Thanks. CISO tentatively available next Tue for the ceremony. Also need mutual NDA added to SOW and for engineers on the call.

emma_sales: Great — next steps: Liam, drop any additional API snippets and the exact per-HSM TPS numbers here. Noah, escalate INC-789 and confirm provisional HSM availability. Olivia, draft the SOW + pricing line items and loop in legal. Anna, I'll ping you to start the security questionnaire responses.

liam_se: Dropping a short perf table — single HSM ~200 TPS (wrap/unwrap), 3 HSMs ~600 TPS with linear scaling for concurrent short ops. For heavy asymmetric ops expect lower TPS. For POC targets we recommend 1 HSM + load tests to validate.

noah_eng_infra: INC-789 opened: https://issues.redwood.ai/INC-789 — assigned to infra-oncall. ETA for confirmation: 48h. :eyes:

emma_sales: Thanks team. I'll sync with the customer after Olivia posts SOW draft.
